name: shopify-to-kc-price-changes-tool
description: PHP pipeline that syncs Shopify variant price changes (via Matrixify CSV) to a KC pricelist.
summary: Keeps Shopify product variant prices in sync with the company’s Khaos Control pricelist by importing recent price changes from Shopify exports, filtering out non-price updates, and generating a list of add, update, or delete actions for the pricelist team. Operations staff run it regularly to ensure pricelist accuracy without manual cross-checking. It solves the problem of manually tracking meaningful price changes and updating the pricelist database efficiently and reliably.
